title: Add duplicate-text and ambiguous-owner diagnostics to source coverage
description:
Finding sources:
- ChatGPT found false ownership of p. 109 Ranger spell-list text by table:circle-of-the-land-forest.
- Codex found 187 ambiguous source-coverage items and 88 normalized duplicate-name groups.
- Duplicate-name examples include Spellcasting, Ability Score Improvement, Druid, Acolyte, Hide, Shield, and Potion of Healing.
- Closed heading/tie-break beads did not eliminate this residual ambiguity.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add source coverage diagnostics for text that can be matched by multiple plausible records, especially across kind/section boundaries.
- Prefer page/section context over global text matches.
- Fail closed or require curated ownership when duplicate text would otherwise prove coverage.
- Include regression cases for spell-list vs subclass table collisions and repeated feature boilerplate.
notes: 2026-07-08 ADR 0017 adjustment: 'Curated ownership' is allowed only as source-grounded curated input, not as hand-curated output. Any duplicate/ambiguous owner registry must be deterministic, source-region tied, schema/parity checked where exhaustive, and fail loudly on source drift.
